product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™12in x 12in Heavy-Duty 2-Inch Spigoted Truss 2m (6.56ft) with HardwareBolt‑free spigoted truss design that is compatible with the standard size systemsSo now the time has come to take your stage production, display and product messaging to a new level. You're going to need something that is stable, easy to transport and simple to setup. We have exactly what you need to help bring your staging and displays visions to life. Each segment of our aluminum box truss weighs less than 20 lbs., this is great news for musicians, DJs, tradeshows and mobile shows of all sizes. Configurations that span up to 2 meters across will support up to 500 lbs., when they're center loaded and if it's evenly loaded this system can handle even more. Although, it is not recommended for speakers or human harnesses. These 12" x 12" frames are super easy to transport and dolly load for truck packs. The 2" outer tubes are just the right convenient size for mounting lights, TV monitors and signage. This Stage Right™ 12" x 12" Aluminum Spigot Truss segments are available in 1m (3.28ft), 1.5m (4.92ft) and 2m (6.56ft) sizes which gives you unlimited configurations at your disposal. Planning your floor space is a breeze when you take advantage of the versatility of the universal 6 way truss corner blocks.
